_comment: Room/group ids per institution, kept up to date by `python main.py
pull-groups` (or the combined `pull-references` weekly run). Do not edit
by hand except in an emergency -- a manual edit survives the next pull
only for institutions/groups that pull does not touch, and is otherwise
overwritten (the pull always backs up the previous file first, timestamped
alongside it, so a bad run or a lost manual edit can be recovered by hand).
<site_code> is a key from reference/catalogue.json's `sites` section.
Unlike reference/session_catalogue.json, group ids are NOT load-bearing
for booking logic today -- nothing in this codebase reads this file yet.
It exists so the ids are available (with readable titles) for whatever
uses them next, without a manual Famly export.
Point GROUPS_CATALOGUE_FILE elsewhere to override the path.
